name: aws-messaging-and-streaming
description: Messaging and streaming skills for the main agent: SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Amazon MQ, Kinesis Data Streams, MSK (incl. migrations), Managed Service for Apache Flink, and customer messaging with SES, SMS/voice, and WhatsApp, plus the SNS/SQS and Amazon MQ MCP servers.
